notes.title: Small bugfix and QoL patch
notes.content: this patch fixes a bug with the harvesting augment who stopped working. allowed multiple camera inputs (keyboard and mouse), as well as small balance patches for the towers.

notes.title: Update on FarmTD 21-09-2024
notes.content:
Hey Farmers,

I'm happy to announce that the current patch brings a lot of new quality of life changes to the UI,
a new tower (not available in the Demo), some balancing changes, as well as the implementation of the Leaderboard function! This way, you can measure your Farming-prowess against those of your friends and other farmers.

As of right now, the game is set to be released in Q1 of 2025. 
There is some key-art still left te be done, as well as balancing and polishing. 
If anyone is interested in helping out, or in helping beta-test new releases, feel free to reach out in the community discord:

 https://discord.gg/VKd77VCWms


Best,
Keyd0s
Developer of FarmTD and The Fanciful Chronicle
